reason: In pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:534, 554, and 576, CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags pass the entire ids slice ("ids", ids) to r.log.Error on every cleanup batch. Because ids is bounded only by the uncapped AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize setting (pkg/setting/setting.go:710, tested up to 32767 in pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/cleanup_test.go:101), this can log thousands of IDs per line.
